name: Arathi Basin
summary: Arathi Basin is a fertile valley in the Arathi Highlands and one of the main fronts in the war between the humans and the Forsaken. The League of Arathor fights to reclaim the lost lands of Arathor for its backers in Stormwind, while the Defilers, elite Forsaken troops under the dreadlord Varimathras, seek to cut the vital link between the humans and their dwarven allies to the south. Both sides battle for the basin's farm, stables, lumber mill, blacksmith and gold mine, whose resources feed the war.

sections.title: The Larder of Arathor
sections.body: Long before the Third War, the basin's fields, mills and mines fed the realm of Stromgarde, heir to ancient Arathor. When Lordaeron fell and Stromgarde crumbled, the valley was left almost undefended, its farmsteads and workshops still standing. Whoever holds them now holds grain, timber, iron and gold, the stuff that keeps an army in the field. That makes the quiet valley one of the most fought-over places in the highlands.

sections.title: The League and the Defilers
sections.body: The League of Arathor is an Alliance company of Stromgarde's survivors and their friends, backed by Stormwind and working out of Refuge Pointe, sworn to reclaim the lands their forebears built. The Defilers are the Forsaken's answer: hardened troops of the Undercity under the watchful eye of Varimathras, operating alongside the Horde at Hammerfall. Their aim is to strip the basin of its riches and sever the road that ties the northern humans to the dwarves of the south.

sections.title: Holding the Basin
sections.body: Five strongpoints decide the battle: the farm, the stables, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the gold mine. Each side races to raise its banner over them and defend what it takes, because every strongpoint held adds to its store of resources. Raiders slip between them to steal a point while the enemy is busy elsewhere, and the side that gathers enough resources first wins the basin, for a time.

faq.answer: Arathi Basin is a battleground in a fertile valley of the Arathi Highlands. The Alliance's League of Arathor and the Forsaken Defilers fight there for control of its farm, stables, lumber mill, blacksmith and gold mine, whose resources feed their war.

faq.q: Who are the League of Arathor?
faq.answer: The League of Arathor is an Alliance company of Stromgarde's survivors and their allies, backed by Stormwind and based near Refuge Pointe. They fight to reclaim the lost lands of Arathor and the riches of the basin.

The Defilers are elite Forsaken troops serving under the dreadlord Varimathras, Lady Sylvanas's lieutenant. Working alongside the Horde at Hammerfall, they aim to seize the basin's resources and sever the link between the humans of the north and their dwarven allies.

faq.q: Why do the Alliance and the Forsaken fight over Arathi Basin?
faq.answer: The basin's farms, mills and mines can feed and arm an army. For the League, winning it back is a step toward restoring Arathor; for the Defilers, taking it starves the humans and cuts them off from their dwarven allies to the south.

faq.q: How is the battle in Arathi Basin won?
faq.answer: Both sides fight to capture and hold the basin's five strongpoints: the farm, stables, lumber mill, blacksmith and gold mine. Each one held adds to its side's resources, and the side that gathers enough first wins.

angles.text: Every strongpoint the League holds is a field of Arathor won back, and grain and iron on their way to Stormwind's soldiers.
Fighting beside the Defilers, the Horde bleeds the humans of the resources they need and keeps them cut off from the dwarves to the south.
These farms fed Stromgarde for generations. For a human, the basin is not a prize but a home to be taken back.
The Forsaken remember the living kingdoms that cast them out. Taking the basin from Arathor's heirs is a cold and fitting revenge.
